title: Children's Bedtime Prayer (Four Angels)
text:
Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John,
bless the bed that I lie on.
Four corners to my bed,
four angels round my head;
one to watch and one to pray,
and two to bear my soul away.
notes: This beloved traditional children's bedtime prayer asks for angelic protection during sleep. The four evangelists (Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John) are invoked to bless the bed, while four guardian angels are asked to watch over the sleeping child. This prayer has comforted children for generations.
description: Traditional children's prayer asking for angelic protection during sleep
